title: SSO rules
summary: Members → SSO rules: the read-only root rule first, the one-click conversion offer for DJDL's old manifest admin group, then the rules (group, verified email domain or claim → a role, scope and areas) with a new rule open in the same RuleEditor the product Access page uses for license.access, including the preview of who it matches and what changes for each.
compare: SSO rules is a tab of Platform → Members, not a separate nav item or a Settings section; the count on the tab is the number of editable rules (3), the root rule not included.

The root rule comes after the rules: a right rail from 1280px and a 56px strip under the editor below it, in the same order at every width. It shows the group with a lock beside its label ('Set at deploy time by PLATFORM_ADMIN_GROUP', From Pocket ID), the role, who matches and no menu.

The rules are a When / Gets / People table: the When cell is the kind and matcher ('Group release-managers', 'Verified email domain studio.example.com') with 'From <connection>' as its second line; Gets is the role tag with its scope and areas; People is the faces and a count; then the row menu.
An email-domain rule shows that its domain is 'Verified and enforced' on the connection; the editor never offers a domain that is unverified or not enforced.

The adminGroup conversion offer is an accent callout naming the product and the group; the 0.9 refusal of product.adminGroup is its tooltip; one button pre-fills a rule mapping the group to that product's admin.

The editor is the shared RuleEditor (same component and words as license.access): 'When someone' reads as a sentence in the order the choices depend on each other: Signs in with [connection], And has [A group | A verified email domain | A claim], then the matcher ('Claim [department] is [djdl-qa]'). 'They get' is Role, Product (or All products) and Areas. A label column puts every control on one left edge. Areas use the Invite drawer's control: 'Every area of DJDL' or 'Only these areas' with service-glyph chips, offering only the product's enabled features.

The preview lists every person who matches from stored sign-ins, each with their current roles and the exact change as one run of text (Adds, with a plus glyph; Joins as DJDL admin the next time Ravi signs in), never a pronoun. A rule matching nobody says 'Nobody matches yet. It applies at their next sign-in.'; a rule that gives Superadmin or Platform admin shows a warning such as 'This rule makes 3 people Superadmins' (Other states).

Saving needs a passkey (the footer says 'Passkey required'); a Superadmin or Platform admin rule first opens a confirmation naming the people, with 'Type Superadmin to confirm' and a danger button 'Make 3 people Superadmins' that stays off until the word matches. The tab's header action is Add rule (primary, Superadmins only); it is hidden while the editor is open, so Save rule is the only filled button. Others (Priya, a Platform admin) see the rules read-only: no Add rule, no row menus, no editor.
Preview and sign-in evaluate the same rule the same way (one evaluator), and the page never offers a deny rule or a rule order: matches only add.

Phone and tablet: each rule stacks (kind tile and When with the menu, then the role tag with its areas on the line under it, then the matches); the editor's clauses stack, labels sit above their controls, the selects and the segmented control take the full width, and the area chips wrap.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fix applied: one filled button, the When clause reads connection first on one left edge, and the high-risk, empty and read-only states are drawn.

findings.issue: Two filled primary buttons (Invite people and Save rule), and the tab's own Add rule is a small outlined button at the bottom of the card.
findings.resolution: On this tab the header action is Add rule (Superadmins only, primary when no editor is open); with the editor open it is disabled and outlined, so Save rule is the only filled button. The bottom Add rule is gone. Invite people stays on the Members tab.

findings.issue: The editor asks for the claim before the connection it comes from, and the selects don't share a left edge.
findings.resolution: When someone now reads: Signs in with [Studio Okta], And has [A group | A verified email domain | A claim], Claim [department] is [djdl-qa]. A 104px label column puts every control on one left edge (x=455 px in the When clause and x=993 px in They get, at 1440), and They get uses the same rows. Segment words match license.access. licenses.access-rule (another area) still puts the group before From; the shared RuleEditor should take the connection-first order there too, which is for that area's designer or the lead.

findings.issue: Only the happy path: no Superadmin or Platform admin warning and typed confirmation, no rule matching nobody, no read-only view.
findings.resolution: Other states: a Superadmin rule's preview with the warning 'This rule makes 3 people Superadmins'; its confirmation dialog naming the three people with confirm-word 'Superadmin' and 'Make 3 people Superadmins' off until it matches, then the passkey; the empty preview 'Matches nobody who has signed in with Studio Okta yet' that still saves; Priya's read-only rules card with no Add rule, no menus and no editor.

findings.issue: Areas are one select here but radios and chips in the Invite drawer, and the select cuts off on phone.
findings.resolution: Areas use the Invite drawer's control: 'Every area of DJDL' / 'Only these areas' and service-glyph chips that wrap on phone; only DJDL's features are offered and the hint says Commerce isn't on for DJDL.

findings.issue: 'Joins as DJDL admin at his next sign-in' assumes a pronoun; on phone the verb sits alone above its object.
findings.resolution: Now 'Joins as DJDL admin the next time Ravi signs in'. The change is one run of inline text (no flex wrap), so a narrow line breaks inside the object, never after the verb.

findings.issue: The rules are a When / Gets / People table, not the sentence row the compare describes; the table scans better.
findings.resolution: Kept the table and updated the compare to describe it, with 'From <connection>' as the When cell's second line.

findings.issue: The New rule editor was fused under the table, its left column had about 150px of dead space, and the dimmed Add rule left no clear primary action.
findings.resolution: The editor is its own raised card with a 24px gap; 'They get' fields share the row grid of 'When someone' (two columns from 1000px of card width, stacked below); 'Matches 3 people' runs full width under both columns; Add rule is a solid primary button, hidden while the editor is open.

findings.issue: The root rule pushed the editable content down and the page order differed by width.
findings.resolution: One order at every width: manifest offer, Rules, editor, Root rule. Root rule is a right rail from 1280px (.page.rail) and a strip under the editor below; the lock sits beside the group label.

findings.issue: The same warning and passkey fact appeared three times; version and mechanism details were developer noise.
findings.resolution: Rules subtitle 'A person gets every rule they match'; manifest banner 'DJDL's manifest names djdl-admins as its admin group' with the 0.9 clause in a tooltip; footer note 'Passkey required'; the typed confirmation stays in the dialog only; Matches subtitle deleted; warning 'Superadmins can change every role and SSO rule'; empty match 'Nobody matches yet. It applies at their next sign-in.'

findings.issue: Tables stretched to about 1615px at 1920, so cells sat 275px or more apart and the page widths differed across the area.
findings.resolution: Pages cap at one content width, centred: 1280px for tables, 1136px for forms and status pages (kit .page.cap-table, .page.cap-form).

findings.issue: Small muted mono keys, dates and helper text carried facts at subtle colour and under 12px; disabled buttons were near invisible; row-menu targets were 28px.
findings.resolution: Fact-bearing small text moves to the muted token and 12px or more; the light subtle token is #4f586d (4.5:1 or better on every surface in both themes); disabled buttons keep a visible border at 0.6 opacity (0.8 on primary); the row-menu trigger is 32px with a 44px hit area (44px on phone); colour-only Adds and Joins carry a glyph.

findings.issue: Other states left 120 to 700px of dead space beside shorter cards, and the captions narrated layout.
findings.resolution: Other states sit on one equal-width grid (3 columns from desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on phone) with the page's card primitive; captions name the state and its trigger.

findings.issue: h1 plus tabs is the kit's pattern; role names and the glossary are owner and consolidation-plan decisions.
findings.resolution: declined: Change the h1 to match each tab, add breadcrumbs on platform pages, or add 'Rename Console access to Viewer' and a glossary entry.

findings.issue: Date and glossary rules belong to the copy rules and the consolidation plan, not to a spacing pass.
findings.resolution: declined: Rewrite dates to 'relative within 7 days, else Oct 6, year only when not current' and add the 'Product admin = one product or all' glossary note.
